an3.39:1.4: From this it would appear that the nivasana is comparable to what bhikkhus call antaravasaka, i.e. a robe that covers the lower parts, worn indoors, i.e. a dhoti or sarong.
an3.39:2.3: _Bilaṅga_ appears in a list of medicinal fruits at [pli-tv-kd6:6.1.4](). It is Sanskrit _viḍaṅga_, identified as _embelia ribes_ or “false black pepper”, commonly used as vermifuge.
